hooks.command: cd $HOME/Ai/CortadOS-Router && python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d["transcript_path"]); print(d.get("session_id","unknown"))' | { read tp; read sid; python3 -B -m cortados_router.compaction.checkpoint build --transcript "$tp" --format claude-code --out "$CORTADOS_HOME/checkpoint/$sid-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"; }
